assumptions.availability: Assumed historical bar close + 2s; not archived arrival timestamps
assumptions.execution: First hourly open strictly after feature availability; no fill at prior close
assumptions.infrastructure_cost: Excluded; no claim of net business profitability

conclusion: Insufficient evidence of a repeatable executable edge. Historical evaluation cannot qualify live trading.
kind: historical replay; not live or forward paper performance

research_registry.fixed_rules: Same model and thresholds; BTC/ETH × 1h/4h, plus fixed momentum/passive benchmarks
research_registry.policy: Retain every planned run, including failed runs; no best-result selection

backtest.cost_basis: configured research estimate, not verified account fees
limitations: No intrabar stop fills
No order-book history
Fixed cost model; no historical liquidity proof
Risk-matched benchmark is allocation-matched only, not volatility-matched
No ETH/BTC cross-asset comparison unless both datasets are ingested

momentum.drawdown_method: hourly close mark-to-market including estimated liquidation cost; intrabar extremes excluded

strategy.drawdown_method: hourly close mark-to-market including estimated liquidation cost; intrabar extremes excluded

forecast.quantile_description: Empirical calibration-residual net-return scenarios, not confidence intervals or guaranteed bounds

validation.overlap_warning: Horizon outcomes overlap in forecast metrics; do not treat samples as independent
validation.reason: No independent forward-paper qualification or approved promotion
validation.sampling: expanding chronological; label purge plus horizon embargo; no shuffled CV

runs.hypothesis: Causal price/volume baseline predicts subsequent return better than expanding class prior and earns a net advantage over cash/passive benchmarks
